seed_derivation: base_seed + first seven hexadecimal digits of SHA256(result-specific seed key)
bootstrap_unit: image; all lesion classes and paired methods retained together
bootstrap_estimator: mean of per-class image means; undefined overlaps excluded within each class
bootstrap_class_coverage: Exclude and count replicates missing any class represented in the original estimand
pairing: same sorted image identifiers and identical reference-defined class eligibility
permutation: two-sided absolute class-balanced paired difference; one common random sign per image
reference_empty_rule: Dice/IoU undefined for reference-empty classes; retain false-positive counts separately
image_macro_rule: Mean of reference-positive class scores; entirely reference-empty images excluded from Dice distribution
negative_image_reporting: Separate negative image counts and false-positive image rates; undefined if no negative records
sampling_scope: test-image variation conditional on fixed outputs; assess patient clustering when patient identifiers are available
timing_protocol: benchmark.py retains every measured iteration; intervals resample run totals, not segmentation pixels
